name: B10-0101/2025 (The Left) – Continuing detention and risk of the death penalty for individuals in Nigeria charged with blasphemy, notably the case of Yahaya Sharif-Aminu
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on continuing detention and risk of the death penalty for individuals in Nigeria charged with blasphemy, notably the case of Yahaya Sharif-Aminu
part_text:
The European Parliament is not changing any law here. It is stating its opinion and calling on Nigeria to release Yahaya Sharif-Aminu, a singer sentenced to death for blasphemy, and to drop the case against him. It also asks Nigeria to stop executions, punish mob killings, and repeal its blasphemy laws. Separately, it asks European Union countries to repeal their own blasphemy and "religious insult" laws.

- Nothing changes yet; these are requests to Nigeria and EU countries.
- It concerns Sharif-Aminu, people accused of blasphemy in Nigeria, and EU laws.
- Next, the text is sent to Nigerian authorities, the African Union, EU bodies and the United Nations.
